notes: The italic nor and of anything answer to no morpheme and are added; the alternative reading folds them into תְּמוּנָה, which rule 42's reasoning about a surplus connective forbids.
The three מִן compounds each fuse to one English word under rule 30; the לְ of מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ is left unrepresented because the article and אֶרֶץ hold the rest of the phrase's English (rule 40).
